sloka: इदं त्वसदृशं कर्म परदाराभिमर्शनम् ।यस्मादेष परक्यासु रमते राक्षसाधमः ।। ७.२४.२० ॥
transliteration: idaṁ tvasadṛśaṁ karma paradārābhimarśanam ।yasmādeṣa parakyāsu ramate rākṣasādhamaḥ ।। 7.24.20 ॥

translations.english: This act of molesting other men's wives is indeed unseemly, because this vilest of Rākṣasas delights in other women.
